meta.title: ELZORA — Egypt, designed by locals
meta.description: Tailor-made Egypt journeys, built with trusted local partners. Tell us what you love and we design the rest.

hero.title: Egypt isn’t a destination. It’s a journey.
hero.subtitle: Tell us what you love. Our local partners design the rest, from the pyramids to the Nile.

journey.title: Follow the journey
journey.subtitle: From the Mediterranean coast to the temples of the Nile.
journey.mapLabel: Map of Egypt with five stops along the Nile

alexandria.title: Bibliotheca Alexandrina
alexandria.text: A tilted granite disc on the Mediterranean, carved with characters from many alphabets: a modern homage to the ancient library.
alexandria.photoAlt: Reading hall of the Bibliotheca Alexandrina

giza.title: The Great Pyramid
giza.text: Built for Pharaoh Khufu around 2560 BC, the last surviving wonder of the ancient world.
giza.secondText: About 73 m long, carved from the limestone bedrock of the Giza plateau.

luxor.title: Sunrise over Hatshepsut’s temple
luxor.text: Drift above Queen Hatshepsut’s terraced temple as the cliffs turn gold.

items.title: Karnak Temple
items.text: Painted columns, carved over 3,000 years ago.

items.title: Luxor Temple
items.text: Floodlit at dusk in the heart of the city.

items.title: Karnak’s obelisks
items.text: Hieroglyph-covered granite, framed by giant columns.
items.alt: An obelisk framed by the columns of Karnak

aswan.title: Where the Nile turns to gold.
aswan.text: Felucca sails, granite islets and palm groves line the river at Aswan.

abuSimbel.title: Ramses II
abuSimbel.text: Colossal statues guard a temple that was moved block by block in the 1960s.

finale.title: Your Egypt is waiting
finale.text: Tell us what you love. Our local partners design the rest.

partners.title: Licensed local partners
partners.text: Each program is run by a local partner company whose license we have verified.

support.title: Talk to us directly
support.text: Send us a message on WhatsApp.

cancellation.title: Clear cancellation terms
cancellation.text: Written into every offer, so you read them before you commit.

styles.title: Which Egypt is yours?
styles.description: Pick the kind of trip that sounds like you. We shape the details together.

trips.title: Itineraries to start from
trips.description: Starting points for your own Egypt. We adapt each one to your dates, pace and budget.

why.title: Egypt, designed by people who know it
why.intro: A trip to Egypt is easy to book and hard to get right. This is how we approach it.
why.imageAlt: Low-angle view of the stone blocks of a pyramid

items.title: Local knowledge
items.text: Routes shaped by people who know Egypt: the right time of day for each temple, and the quieter way to see it.

items.title: Planning around you
items.text: Tell us what you love, when you can travel and how you like to move. Your itinerary is built from that, not from a catalogue.

items.title: Transparent pricing
items.text: Every offer states what is included, the price and when payment is due, before you commit to anything.

items.title: Human support
items.text: Write to us and a person answers. Ask your questions in plain words, as often as you need.

items.title: Carefully chosen partners
items.text: Local partner companies build and run your program, and we choose which ones to work with.

transparency.title: How ELZORA earns
transparency.text: We don’t build or run the trips ourselves. Local partner companies do, and they pay us a commission for the travelers we bring them. You can ask us about it at any time.

reviews.title: In their own words
reviews.summary: Rated {rating} out of 5 from {count} verified traveler reviews

faq.title: Questions, answered
faq.description: Straight answers to the questions we hear most.
faq.contactText: Ask us directly. A person will answer.

finalCta.title: Ready for your Egypt?
finalCta.text: Tell us what you love and when you can travel. We’ll design the rest with our local partners.

meta.title: Plan your trip to Egypt
meta.description: Tell us when you would like to travel, who is coming and what you love. We pass your request to a suitable local tour partner. No payment, no commitment.

intro.title: Let’s plan your Egypt
intro.text: Answer a few short questions, one at a time. It takes about two minutes, and nothing is booked or paid here.
points: Matched with a suitable local tour partner
Your details are used only to answer your request

common.requiredNote: All questions are required unless marked optional.

when.title: When would you like to visit Egypt?
when.hint: You don’t need exact dates. Tell us what you know today.

specific.title: I have specific dates
specific.text: I know when I can arrive and leave.

flexible.title: My dates are flexible
flexible.text: I can travel around a certain time.

when.flexibleWhen: When would you prefer to travel?
when.flexibleHint: Pick a season or a month. Egypt can be visited all year.

who.title: Who is travelling?
who.hint: Use the buttons to change the numbers.
who.agesHint: Their age at the time of travel helps us suggest suitable options.

experience.title: What kind of experience are you looking for?
experience.hint: Choose as many as you like.

history.title: Ancient Egypt & History
history.text: Pyramids, temples and tombs, with context.

nile.title: Nile Cruise
nile.text: Slow days on the river between Luxor and Aswan.

redsea.title: Red Sea & Beaches
redsea.text: Sun, swimming and snorkelling by the coast.

desert.title: Desert & Adventure
desert.text: Oases, dunes and nights under the stars.

culture.title: Culture & Local Experiences
culture.text: Markets, food and everyday life with locals.

family.title: Family Holiday
family.text: An easy pace and experiences for all ages.

romantic.title: Romantic Escape
romantic.text: Quiet moments and special places for two.

everything.title: A bit of everything
everything.text: A mix of the above. We’ll suggest the balance.

duration.title: How long would you like to stay?

budget.title: What is your approximate budget?
budget.hint: Please think per person, for the whole trip, in euros.
budget.note: This only helps us suggest suitable options. It is not a quote, and we can’t promise a specific itinerary or price at this stage.

contact.title: How can we reach you?
contact.hint: We use these details only to prepare and answer your trip request.
contact.emailHint: Your confirmation will be sent here.
contact.phoneHint: Optional. Include the country code, for example +49.
contact.privacyNote: Nothing is booked or charged through this form.

review.title: Review your trip request
review.hint: Check your answers. You can change any of them without losing the rest.
